justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/PackageManager.java`, `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/JITDataModel.java`, `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/treevisitor/TreeVisitor.java`, `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/util/HeadlessUtil.java`, and `core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestPackageManager.java`. `PackageManager` is a small 143-line class with 3 state fields, 6 public methods, and 1 private helper; all behavior is tightly centered on one concern: maintaining the package/class maps and building the package tree. Call sites use it only to create/look up packages and read root packages, and the tests cover only those behaviors. I did not see evidence of multiple unrelated responsibilities or clear need to split it further.
